mapper.select: SELECT id, package_id, appoint_date, time_range, max_count, current_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM appointment_slot WHERE package_id = #{packageId} AND appoint_date = #{date} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY time_range ASC
SELECT id, package_id, appoint_date, time_range, max_count, current_count, status, create_time, update_time FROM appointment_slot WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE appointment_slot SET current_count = current_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND current_count < max_count AND deleted = 0
UPDATE appointment_slot SET current_count = current_count - 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND current_count > 0 AND deleted = 0
